title: Personalized Group Relative Policy Optimization for Heterogenous Preference Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2603.10009v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Despite their sophisticated general-purpose capabilities, Large Language Models (LLMs) often fail to align with diverse individual preferences because standard post-training methods, like Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF), optimize for a single, global objective. While Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is a widely adopted on-policy reinforcement learning framework, its group-based normalization implicitly assumes that all samples are exchangeable, inheriting this limitation in personalized settings. This assumption conflates distinct user reward distributions and systematically biases learning toward dominant preferences while suppressing minority signals. To address this, we introduce Personalized GRPO (P-GRPO), a novel alignment framework that decouples advantage estimation from immediate batch statistics. translated_title: 面向异构偏好对齐的个性化组相对策略优化
translated_abstract: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）具备强大的通用能力，但由于标准的后训练方法（如基于人类反馈的强化学习RLHF）优化的是单一的全局目标，它们往往无法与多样化的个人偏好对齐。虽然组相对策略优化（GRPO）是一种被广泛采用的在线策略强化学习框架，但其基于组的归一化隐含地假设所有样本是可交换的，这在个性化场景中继承了这一局限性。该假设混淆了不同用户的奖励分布，并系统性地将学习偏向主导偏好，同时抑制少数群体的信号。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了个性化GRPO（P-GRPO），这是一种新颖的对齐框架，它将优势估计与即时批次统计解耦，通过针对偏好组特定的奖励历史而非当前批次统计进行优势归一化……
tldr: 提出个性化组相对策略优化（P-GRPO），通过基于偏好组特定的奖励历史而非即时批次统计进行优势归一化，解决了GRPO在异构偏好对齐中混淆不同用户奖励分布、偏向主导偏好而抑制少数信号的问题。
en_tdlr: We propose Personalized GRPO (P-GRPO), which decouples advantage estimation from immediate batch statistics by normalizing against preference-group-specific reward histories, addressing GRPO's conflation of distinct user reward distributions and its systematic bias toward dominant preferences in heterogeneous preference alignment.
